excluded_items.note: A pathway needing compression adds it as a NAMED extra item (purification: compression electricity).
excluded_items.source: AmCraX flowsheet has no product compressor (PSA at cracker pressure; Cho Comp2 compresses H2 to 180 bar)

location_factor_singapore.note: CAPEX multiplier 0.5-1.5 (Cho Table 8) covers it in sensitivity.
location_factor_singapore.source: No sourced Singapore location factor; Korea-based Cho costs used as is

method.note: Rejected: legacy plant-level correlation (Ahmad 2025 Fig. 6; lcoh.py) and the Phase 1 Farokhi feed-scaled estimate (singapore.py capex_mode 'equipment'). Both remain selectable for comparison.
method.source: AmCraX Phase 2 selection (docs/research/unified_baseline.md): itemised installed cost of the Cho et al. 2026 Ni-24.34 bar plant, each item scaled to AmCraX with the equipment exponent, product compressor removed, Cho OSBL/engineering/contingency factors applied

reference_discount_rate.note: used only to convert Cho unit CAPEX to installed cost

reference_operating_hours_h_per_yr.note: used only to convert Cho unit CAPEX to installed cost

reference_plant_h2_kg_h.note: Cho does not tabulate H2 output in the main text.
reference_plant_h2_kg_h.source: Cho 2026 Ni-24.34 bar: (630 kg/h NH3 feed + 1.736 kmol/h x 17.031 fuel NH3) / 8.011 kg NH3/kg H2 (p. 6 Table 2, p. 13 Table 7); research/notes/cho2026nickel.md

reference_plant_life_yr.note: used only to convert Cho unit CAPEX to installed cost

reference_plant_nh3_feed_kmol_h.note: Size driver of every scaled item.
reference_plant_nh3_feed_kmol_h.source: Cho 2026 p. 6 Table 2: NH3 feed 630 kg/h / 17.031 kg/kmol

scaling_exponent.note: Sensitivity 0.6 (six-tenths rule) and 0.7451 (Ahmad 2025 Fig. 6, plant level).

size_driver.note: reactor may be switched to 'catalyst_mass' (ratio of catalyst inventories, Cho inventory from its 9000 mL/(g h) space velocity) by override reactor_size_driver; heat exchangers and PSA accept caller size ratios (e.g. area) via item_size_ratio.
size_driver.source: AmCraX choice: equipment throughput follows the NH3 feed (cracked gas = 2 mol per mol NH3)

tpsa_split_psa_adsorber.note: Needed because purification and singapore.py report PSA and adsorber separately.
tpsa_split_psa_adsorber.source: Chopra 2026 p. 5 Fig. 5(a) PSA 26 % : adsorber 4 % of TCI, used only to split the Cho T/PSA item

unit_capex_USD_per_kg_h2.note: ISBL = total / ((1+OSBL)(1+eng+cont)) = 0.409; the 0.015 ISBL not itemised in the table is carried as 'other_isbl' (derived).
unit_capex_USD_per_kg_h2.source: Cho 2026 p. 13 Table 7 / Fig. 8, Ni-24.34 bar column (as recorded in research/notes/cho2026nickel.md)

rate_SGD_per_tCO2e.note: SGD 45/tCO2e for emissions year 2026 and any later year; no later step is legislated (50 to 80 by 2030 is a stated aim only)
rate_SGD_per_tCO2e.source: Carbon Pricing Act 2018, Third Schedule Part 1 para 1(c)

treatment.note: Default. A hypothetical life-cycle carbon price is a separate, labelled case and is never described as Singapore law.
treatment.source: NEA carbon tax: Scope 1 facility emissions, threshold 25,000 tCO2e/yr (data/singapore.yaml)

fx_SGD_per_USD.note: Read at the source on 2026-11-23 (latest published reference date 2026-11-20). Cross-check: ADB Asian Bonds Online shows 1.290 at the close of 20 Nov 2026 (singapore.yaml, Phase 1 value), difference 0.12 %. Supersedes the Phase 1 rate 1.290.
fx_SGD_per_USD.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates, 20 Nov 2026: 1 EUR = 1.0990 USD and 1.4160 SGD; cross rate 1.4160 / 1.0990 = 1.288444 SGD per USD

usd_per_eur.note: Used to convert EUR-denominated literature prices (Pd membrane, Richard 2024). Supersedes the Phase 1 parity assumption 1.0 in purification_study.py.
usd_per_eur.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rate, 20 Nov 2026

discount_rate.note: No Singapore WACC sourced. Cho 2026 uses 0.085 (sensitivity).
discount_rate.source: Kum et al. 2026 p. 8 Table 5 (also Farokhi 2025 Table 4, Chopra 2026 Table 2, Ahmad 2025 Eq. 12)

g_and_a_frac_fixed_opex.note: Applied to labour + maintenance + insurance + overhead (AmCraX interpretation, unchanged from Phase 1).

labour_USD_per_yr.note: No Singapore labour rate sourced; kept from the Phase 1 library. Not scaled with capacity.
labour_USD_per_yr.source: Chopra et al. 2026 p. 4 Table 2 (India basis, 4 per shift)

cho2026.note: Used by the catalyst-comparison Cho reconstruction.

legacy_v1.note: Only to reproduce the legacy stored LCOH 3.918842 USD/kg (version 1 basis).

operating_hours_h_per_yr.note: Capacity factor 0.913 (8000/8760, derived). Range 7000 (Kum 2026 Table 5) to 8000.

h2_product_kg_h.note: PSA product at 0.85 recovery (assumption F4 of the stored model), 99.96 mol% H2.

nh3_feed_kmol_h.note: Plant capacity basis of the reference scenario (1,700 kg/h NH3).

stored_baseline.source: Aspen Plus V15 stored baseline (600 degC, 20 bar, heat integration on); case_id baseline

ahmad_reproduction_hours.note: used only to reproduce Ahmad's LCOE
ahmad_reproduction_hours.source: Ahmad 2025: TCI x CRF(10 %, 25 y) / (0.06433 USD/kWh x 43.1 MW)

cracker_fixed_om_frac_tci.source: Ahmad 2025 p. 8: maintenance 2.5 % + insurance 2 % of TCI

operating_hours_h_per_yr.note: Ahmad 2025 implies 7200 h (named field ahmad_reproduction_hours); hours sensitivity 3000-8000 in enduse_run.py.
operating_hours_h_per_yr.source: Same as the cracker (one price set for the H1 comparison, Phase 1 choice)

price_year_label: mixed nominal USD: CAPEX 2024 USD (Cho 2026 analysis year); Singapore prices 2026; no escalation index

default_nh3_scenario.note: Reference baseline numbers are quoted at the grey scenario.

electricity_USD_per_kWh.note: Not an industrial contract price (none found). Supersedes 0.084 (Cho 2026, used by the Phase 1 purification study and the legacy model) and 0.14013 (same derivation at FX 1.290).
electricity_USD_per_kWh.source: EMA USEP 2025 monthly mean (116.6 SGD/MWh, secondary_web) + SP Group network 0.0610 + fees 0.0031 SGD/kWh (Q4 2026, official), divided by fx_SGD_per_USD; components in data/singapore.yaml

h2_selling_price_USD_per_kg.note: Used only for NPV, IRR and payback. Production-cost marker, not a Singapore price.
h2_selling_price_USD_per_kg.source: Argus Hydrogen and Future Fuels 26-01 (6 Jan 2026) p. 2, NE Asia SMR incl. capex (PDF read by the independent review)

blue.source: S&P Global Platts blue ammonia, July 2025: mean of Far East Asia 400 and NW Europe 574 (search-result snippet)

grey.note: Default scenario. International basis, not a Singapore transaction price.

electricity_USD_per_kWh.source: low: Cho 2026 Table 4; high: SP Group regulated tariff Q4 2026 0.2859 SGD/kWh / fx
